title: Oslo peace process dinner: Clinton presses Arafat to take the deal; first impression of Putin

tellings.quote: And he says to Arafat, "Take the deal, Yasser. Take the deal. It's your last best chance for peace."

plain: Rolf Mowatt-Larssen, a former senior CIA officer, says that at a 1998 dinner at the royal castle in Oslo, Norway, he heard Bill Clinton press the Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat: "Take the deal, Yasser. Take the deal. It's your last best chance for peace." He tells Michels this as someone who was there, along with his first impression of Vladimir Putin at the same gathering.
